name: Sant Iscle de Vallalta (Spain)
description: White field with the red rose of the arms, seeded yellow and barbed green, in the second vertical third, and two green triangles at the base forming a valley.
history: The flag was approved on 28 October 1994 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1972 of 14 November 1994; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, white, with the red rose of the arms of diameter 1/3 of the length in the second vertical third at 1/6 from the upper edge, and two green triangles at the base representing a valley, a canting sign alluding to the name.

features.role: rose seeded yellow and barbed green, 1/3 of the length
two triangles at the base representing a valley
